name: Above-ground roguelike inspired by Shattered Pixel Dungeon

mentions.name: Above-ground roguelike inspired by Shattered Pixel Dungeon
mentions.description: An early-stage roguelike game inspired by Shattered Pixel Dungeon, set mostly above ground instead of dungeons, with more variability and character interactions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m in the early stages of making a game similar to shattered pixel but I want it to be mostly above ground instead of dungeons and have more variability and character interactions.
